notes: Alarm-o-Bot - start of YOUR turn only; a random MINION in hand, not any card. An empty hand leaves the Bot where it is
Secretkeeper - "whenever a Secret is played", either player's, so no PayloadIsMine
Tinkmaster Overspark - ANOTHER random minion, either side. EX1_tk29 is the 5/5 Devilsaur, EX1_tk28 the 1/1 Squirrel; the coin flip is OneOf so exactly one transform happens
Leeroy Jenkins - Charge is printed data. EX1_116t is Leeroy's OWN 1/1 Whelp; ds1_whelptoken is Onyxia's and is indistinguishable by stats
Nat Pagle - the coin flip is only rolled on your own turn, so the seeded stream is consumed once a turn cycle
The Beast -> 3/3 Finkle Einhorn on the OPPONENT's side
Mad Scientist - `issecret` is the card PROPERTY, not the `secret` ZONE; it comes out of the DECK. PlaySecret refuses a duplicate of an active Secret and it is discarded instead
Deathlord - the OPPONENT's deck onto the OPPONENT's board; Taunt is printed data. Both the selector and the op need `enemy` -- one says whose deck, the other whose board

Stalagg - DiedThisGame, not the graveyard (which also holds milled and burned copies). The second clause is the simultaneous-death rule: both deathrattles queue in one batch, so without it a mutual kill would summon two Thaddius where Hearthstone summons one
Feugen - mirror of Stalagg; same simultaneous-death guard
Nerub'ar Weblord - taxes BOTH players' hands; Battlecry is read from the printed tag since hand cards carry no script
Undertaker - "whenever YOU summon", so summoned rather than played; Undertaker has no deathrattle of its own so it cannot feed itself
Fel Reaver - the OPPONENT plays anything, YOUR deck loses its top 3. MillDeck takes from the end of the array, which is the top
Piloted Shredder - collectible 2-cost minions only; the pool never yields tokens
Lil' Exorcist - Taunt is printed data; granted deathrattles count because the filter asks the live entity
Hobgoblin - exactly 1 Attack, and PLAYED from hand rather than summoned, so a Shredder's pilot is not buffed
Piloted Sky Golem - collectible 4-cost minions only
Enhance-o Mechano - each minion rolls INDEPENDENTLY, which is what ForEach-around-OneOf buys; one OneOf around a ForEach would give them all the same keyword
Recombobulator - `cost=target` reads the chosen minion's CURRENT cost, so a discounted or Weblord-taxed minion rerolls at the cost it actually has

Foe Reaper 4000 - only when HE attacks, per the printed text. ATTACK_DECLARED rather than PRE_ATTACK so a cancelled attack (Freezing Trap) splashes nothing; the queued ops still run before ProcessDeaths, so a defender killed by the blow is still on the board and its neighbours are still reachable
Sneed's Old Shredder - collectible legendary minions

cond: PayloadIsMine and PayloadCostAtMost(1) and not PayloadCostAtMost(0)
notes: Gazlowe - EXACTLY 1 mana. PayloadCostAtMost(1) alone would fire on The Coin and every other 0-cost spell, so the second clause pins the lower bound
Blingtron 3000 - a random weapon for EACH player; each roll is independent and either may replace a weapon already equipped
Bloodsail Raider - reads the equipped weapon's CURRENT attack; no weapon is a 0 buff
Captain's Parrot - a random Pirate MOVED out of your deck into your hand; no Pirate in the deck is simply nothing

Lorewalker Cho - the copy goes to the OTHER player whichever side Cho is on, which is what the If/else buys: `enemy` is relative to Cho, not to the caster. CARD_PLAYED + PayloadIsSpell rather than SPELL_CAST so Secrets count as spells too -- SPELL_CAST is never raised for them

ops: If(MyTurn){If(not Count(friendly.hand, 3)){Draw(1)}; If(not Count(friendly.hand, 3)){Draw(1)}; If(not Count(friendly.hand, 3)){Draw(1)}}{If(not Count(enemy.hand, 3)){DrawEnemy(1)}; If(not Count(enemy.hand, 3)){DrawEnemy(1)}; If(not Count(enemy.hand, 3)){DrawEnemy(1)}}
notes: Jeeves - EACH turn end, and the player who drew is the one whose turn ended, hence the MyTurn split. Unrolled three times because there is no draw-up-to-N op and no subtraction in the amount DSL; three is the most a hand below 3 can need, and an empty deck correctly takes fatigue each time
Faceless Manipulator - the enchantment layer is copied after the transform, so it becomes the CURRENT 6/7 Yeti rather than a printed 4/5. REQ_NONSELF_TARGET is printed, so it cannot copy itself

Ancient Mage - `adjacent` is the neighbours of SELF, and the battlecry runs with the Mage already in its chosen slot, so the two it lands between are the right two. A granted bonus, not the printed spellDamage field
Baron Rivendare - a top-level script FIELD, not ops: Game:ProcessDeaths queues each deathrattle that many times. Highest multiplier wins rather than multiplying, so two Barons are still two triggers

Kezan Mystic - moves between secret zones and re-homes ownership. It picks among Secrets you do not already have; only when every one is a duplicate is a random one destroyed instead (Ops.StealSecret; hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Kezan_Mystic)
